package.description: The frontline communications and employee engagement app that connects every employee with the modern workplace.

en-US.description: The frontline communications and employee engagement app that connects every employee with the modern workplace.
en-US.longDescription: Blink connects frontline and desk-based employees with one app for critical communications, chat, stories, live streaming, voice and video calling, digital forms, and task management. It gives every employee direct access to what they need, with offline mode, single sign-on, and AI-assisted experiences, so teams stay informed and engaged from anywhere.
en-US.name: Blink

zh-CN.description: 一线沟通与员工互动应用，将每位员工与现代化职场连接起来。
zh-CN.longDescription: Blink 通过一款应用连接一线与办公室员工，提供关键沟通、聊天、动态、直播、语音与视频通话、数字表单和任务管理。每位员工都可以直接访问所需内容，并支持离线模式、单点登录与 AI 辅助体验，让团队无论身处何地都能保持知情与参与。
